author: stoptryharding
title: DragonSense
tagline: NPCs hear what the world announces, from a dragon's roar to the Greybeards' summons
description: Gives SkyrimNet NPCs awareness of world-scale sound. The plugin detects a dragon's flight roar through its sound record, measures how far away the dragon is, and raises its own dragonsense_event; two triggers turn that into either a stored event they will remember or an authored narration that provokes a reaction. Also narrates the Greybeards' summons after the dragon at the Western Watchtower falls.
